gen_layer_config: generate an optimal per-layer quantization config for a model using delta loss scoring and DP bit-budget optimization
get_score_for_scheme: score a quantization scheme by computing mixed weight and activation quantization loss across all quantizable layers
choose_bits_per_layer_with_path: solve a DP knapsack problem to pick the best per-layer quantization scheme within a total bit budget
cal_imatrix: compute the activation importance matrix for a model by accumulating squared activation norms across a calibration dataset
model_forward_low_gpu: run a block-by-block forward and backward pass with gradient checkpointing to score quantization under low GPU memory
